programme.title: American Empire
programme.desc: This epic of America's westward march stars Leo Carrillo and Preston Foster in a tale of men building a cattle empire, only to battle rustlers, the weather, and each other! The romantic adventure from director William C. McGann (In Old California, Alcatraz Island) features a strong leading performance by Oscar nominated RKO star Richard Dix (Cimarron, The Ghost Ship) plus cinematography by six-time Oscar nominee Russell Harlan (To Kill a Mockingbird, Rio Bravo).

programme.title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
programme.desc: The Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, killing all but one. The surviving ranger is nursed back to health by Native American Tonto, and takes on the identity of a masked vigilante, determined to bring all outlaws to justice. Culled from episodes of the popular TV series, this feature is great fun for fans of the Lone Ranger. Starring Clayton Moore and Jay Silverheels.

programme.title: Adventures of Gallant Bess
programme.desc: Rather than a gorgeous Hollywood starlet, actor Cameron Mitchell (Carousel), playing cowboy Ted Daniels, shares the screen in this film with a magnificent wild horse named Gallant Bess, who he tames, trains and keeps for himself. But after Ted is gravely injured in a fixed rodeo, Bess is stolen away from him and forced to join a cruel traveling carnival in this fast-paced western from director Lew Landers (The Adventures of Rin Tin Tin).

programme.title: The Two Gun Man
programme.desc: Ken Maynard stars in this vintage western about ranchers under threat from hired gunmen. Director Phil Rosen, whose career dated back to working with Thomas Edison and included several Charlie Chan features, keeps the action hot with help from a strong ensemble, including Charles King, Murdock MacQuarrie, and a horse named Tarzan! Maynard plays Blackie Weed, a marshall going undercover to capture and arrest some cattle rustlers.He finds himself up against some very bad men, and he's soon framed for murder. Watch as Blackie blazes his way to vindication with a .45 in either hand and the flame of righteous anger in his eyes... Kitty: Nita Martin. Joe Kearney: Lafe McKee. Lem Tolliver: Tom London. Ranch Foreman: Walter Perry

programme.title: Fugitive of the Plains
programme.desc: In this continuation of the much loved Billy the Kid serials featuring dreamboat Buster Crabbe (perhaps best known for his numerous appearances as Flash Gordon in the 30s and 40s), Billy finds himself joining an outlaw band led by women in order to, once again, clear his name after being wrongly accused of a crime he did not commit. Helmed by famed B-movie director Sam Newfield, this film also features Al St. John, whose lovable Fuzzy character was as essential to the PRC's Billy the Kid series as Billy himself.

programme.title: Revenge of the Virgins (Edited Version)
programme.desc: The angry and topless female members of a Native American prepare for battle when white treasure hunters move in on their sacred ground. Peter Perry Jr. (The Secret Sex Lives of Romeo and Juliet) directed this early nudie-cutie from a script by legendary cult filmmaker Ed Wood (Plan Nine from Outer Space). Writing under the pen name Peter LaRoche, Wood churned out this screenplay just before he reinvented himself as the author of seedy adult novels.

programme.title: Broadway to Cheyenne
programme.desc: A gang of big-city thugs trying to set up a protection racket out west meet their match in this B-Western from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Rex Bell, billed on the old print ads as The heroic idol of young America! stars as Breezy Kildare, a New York detective who happens to be in Wyoming. When Breezy leads a group of cattleman against the well-armed city boys, the bad guys will wish theyd stayed in New York! The rest of the cast includes such favorites from the period as George Gabby Hayes, Roy DArcy, and Marceline Day. (Day worked opposite everyone from John Wayne to Buster Keaton, but retired from acting shortly after this movie at age 25.) Directed by Harry L. Fraser.

programme.title: Neath Canadian Skies
programme.desc: It's the mounties versus claim jumpers in this drama from Golden Gate Pictures. Based on an action-packed novel by James Oliver Curwood and directed by B. Reeves Maynard (Undersea Kingdom, The Phantom Empire), the film features an outstanding cast of Poverty Row regulars, including Russell Hayden, Inez Cooper, Cliff Nazarro, I. Stanford Jolley, and Kermit Maynard. For movie buffs: Cinematographer Marcel Le Picard began his career in the silent era and finished with exactly 200 credits!

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and his sidekick Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West, dispatched by the government to investigate crimes threatening the young nation. Starring Russell Hayden and Jackie Coogan. This episode, Hangfire, also stars Phil Arnold, Dorothy Patrick, and Herman Hack.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West, dispatched by the government to investigate crimes threatening the young nation. In Hush Money, the G-men are trying to clear a title for a ranch when they discover a murder. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: In Ghost Town Mystery, Pat and Stoney investigate the mysterious closing of a government silver mine and the ghost town left in its wake. They meet several suspicious characters in the empty town, one of whom holds the answers they seek. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat and Stoney are dispatched to Central City to investigate the disappearance of two Postal Inspectors. They are puzzled by the large amount of mail being sent to the post office in the town of El Dorado. Puzzled, because El Dorado has been a ghost town for years. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.desc: Uncle Joe tries to convince two rich women that Shady Rest is a farm. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Directed by Guy Scarpitta..Series created by Paul Henning. Episode first aried in February of 1964.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.sub-title: S01 : E21 The Very Old Antique
programme.desc: Homer Bedloe (Charles Lane) tries to sell the Cannonball to a rich man as an antique.Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Directed by Jean Yarbrough. Series created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in 1964.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Spur Line to Shady Rest
programme.desc: The Shady Rest hotel is threatened when a railroad detective comes to investigate a forgotten spur line on the property. Creator Paul Henning followed up the success of The Beverly Hillbillies with this charming CBS comedy that ran for 222 episodes. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Episode first aired in 1963.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Quick Hide the Railroad
programme.desc: Kate uses her charms to keep Homer Bedloe from catching the train to Pixley. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Bedloe: Charles Lane. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in 1963.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. In this episode, a couple of con men attempt to snare Letty into their scheme and spirit her away to San Francisco. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: In this episode, a Texas Ranger is shot down in cold blood. Determined to bring the killer to justice, the Judge and Jeff turn their focus on Curly, but with a lack of evidence the lawmen are patient until they break the case. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.sub-title: S01 : E22 Luck O' The Irish
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery. In this episode, Judge Roy and Taggart are intrigued by the arrival of Pat O'Hara and his much younger wife Kate. Pat's fondess for drink and gambling has him involved with the town's rowdies who are eying his beautiful bride. The Judge helps sort things out.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. In this episode, Deputy Jeff Taggart is cheated in a horse deal. When the trader is found murdered, Jeff is the chief suspect. Judge Bean has to discover the actual murderer to save his friend from the gallows. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: In this episode, Judge Bean appoints himself as the legal guardian of a young man whose father was a member of an outlaw gang. Bean's reward -- the boy's uncle puts a $3000 bounty on his head ! Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. In this episode, the Judge deals with a rigged election. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: A young boy runs away from home because he thinks his father is a coward for not standing up to his abusive boss. Jeff and Roy have to find the boy and convince him that his father is just doing what he has to do in order to provide for his family. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. In this episode, a woman arrives in town looking for her son. Roy checks around, and finds out that her son is not only in the area, but has become a notorious outlaw. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Daniel Boone, Trailblazer
programme.desc: Daniel Boone (Bruce Bennett) battles Shawnee warriors as he leads a band of settlers into Kentucky in this frontier potboiler from Albert C. Gannaway Productions. Made at the height of Hollywood's fascination with pioneer days, the film also stars Lon Chaney Jr. as Chief Blackfish, and country singer Faron Young as a handsome young suitor for Boone's daughter. There's plenty of action and danger here as the Shawnee are convinced that Boone is trying to steal their land. But Boone is ready, not even fearing death by tomahawk. It isn't how you die, Boone says. It's what you live for.

programme.title: Cry Blood Apache (Edited Version)
programme.desc: An Apache brave seeks vengeance on a band of sadistic gold hunters in this bloody drive-in western. Pitcalin (Jody McRae) leads the marauders who wipe out an Apache camp when they discover gold, only to watch their violent deeds lead to their own demise. Featuring a superb cast that also includes Dan Kemp, Robert Tessier, and Joel McRae, this coldblooded western tale was directed by character actor and filmmaker Jack Starrett (Cleopatra Jones, The Losers).

programme.title: Hell Town
programme.desc: In Hell Town (aka Born to the West) John Wayne is back in the saddle as two-fisted Dare Rudd, a roaming cowhand trying to prove he can win a woman's love and outwit a crooked saloon owner. This exciting B-movie from Paramount Pictures was based on a novel by western writer Zane Grey. With a wild and wooly cast that includes Johnny Mack Brown, Marsha Hunt, Monte Blue, and Lucian Littlefield, director Charles Barton (Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein) gives us a tale of romance, action, and high stakes gambling!

programme.title: Winds of the Wasteland
programme.desc: John Wayne stars in this Republic Pictures western about the final days of the Pony Express. Former rider John Blair (Wayne) enters a coach race to win a $25,000 government mail contract, but there are dozens of obstacles in his path. The rest of the cast includes Lane Chandler and Phyllis Fraser, plus Lew Kelly (Lady of Burlesque) doing a great comic turn as Rocky OBrien, the eccentric, self-proclaimed mayor of a deserted mining town.

programme.title: In Old Colorado
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy and his crew get involved in a war over water rights in this feature from Harry Sherman Productions and Paramount Pictures. The intrigue starts when crafty Joe Weller (Morris Ankrum) turns two ranchers against each other, which leads to dire results. This is the 33rd of 66 Hopalong Cassidy movies, with WIlliam Boyd in the role he made famous. Also, look for regular Hoppy co-stars Russell Hayden as Lucky Jenkins, and Andy Clyde as California Carson.

programme.title: Hoppy Serves a Writ
programme.desc: Sheriff Hopalong Cassidy triumphs again in this lighthearted western romp from Harry Sherman Productions. Good ol' Hoppy (William Boyd) has to leave his beloved Texas to track down some bad guys in Oklahoma. You can bet that the action and suspense will follow Hopalong wherever he goes. Also, look for a number of familiar faces in the ast, including TV's future Superman George Reeves, notorious Hollywood heavy Victor Jory, and in his first credited role, Robert Mitchum! In fact, Mitchum would appear in more of Hoppy's adventures before branching out on his own and becoming one of Hollywood's greatest stars. Also featuring Jan Christy, Forbes Murray, Byron Foulger, Earle Hodgins, and Roy Barcroft. Directed by Goerge Archainbaud.

programme.title: The Outlaw
programme.desc: Billy the Kid, Pat Garrett, and Doc Holliday ride again in Howard Hughes' epic 1943 western, but the character you'll remember most is sultry country vixen Rio McDonald. Hughes' nationwide search for an actress to play Rio resulted in the film debut of Jane Russell, whose natural assets were allegedly helped by a special bra designed by Hughes. When The Outlaw finally received a nationwide release in 1946, its success vindicated Hughes and made Russell a star. As for Hughes' infamous bra, Russell said in her 1988 memoir, I never wore it, and he never knew.

programme.title: Range War
programme.desc: William Boyd returns in the 25th of 66 Hopalong Cassidy adventures. This time Hopalong goes undercover to expose a group of ranchers who are interfering with the building of a new railroad. Also, look for Russell Hayden as Lucky Jenkins, and Britt Wood as Speedy McGinnis. It's a great, action-packed adventure from director Leslie Selander (Flight to Mars, Riders of the Range), and further proof that no one pushes Hoppy around and gets away with it!

programme.title: The Red Rope
programme.desc: Hired killers and Old West outlaws stand front and center in this riveting tale from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Bob Steele, one of the busiest stars in movie history (everything from the silent era to Republic Pictures to working with Clint Eastwood in Hang Em High) is here as Tom Shaw, the target of a bad mans desperation and hate. Steele appeared in more than 240 movies and television shows, but was never more impressive than in The Red Rope!

programme.title: Stagecoach to Denver
programme.desc: Ride the outlaws' highway! Allan Rocky Lane stars as Red Ryder, shootin' and fightin' his way to justice in this old slugfest from Republic Pictures. This time he's a stagecoach driver battling a crooked land commissioner and his cohorts, including a sheriff on the take. Robert Blake costars as Little Beaver!

programme.title: A Lust to Kill
programme.desc: An imprisoned outlaw escapes and goes on the hunt for his brothers murderers, who just happen to be members of the outlaws own gang. He and his beloved hit the trail, but are pursued by local law enforcement, who have their own plans for justice. Starring Don Megowan, Jim Davis, and Allison Hayes.

programme.title: Law of the Pampas
programme.desc: Murder below the Equator...and Hopalong Cassidy races to action in the heart of the wild Pampas country !Hoppy (William Boyd) and his pal Lucky (Russell Hayden) head to South America to look after a herd of cattle sold by Cassidy's boss to an Argentine rancher. Unfortunately, the scoundrel Ralph Merritt (Sidney Blackmer) wants the cattle, and he's not above hiring some dangerous characters to do his dirty work. It's a test of blazing guns...under a blazing sun! Can the boys of Bar 20 lay down the law in a lawless place like the Pampas? Can Hoppy and his gang succeed in what is truly a last frontier? Watch and see!

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Cisco and Pancho protect a man being chased by outlaws who believe he is responsible for a gold robbery. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951. This episode aired in 1950.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Quantrill and His Raiders
programme.desc: Jim Davis stars as Matt Clark, a railroad detective tasked with the mission to infiltrate the Quantrill gang before the Lawrence Kansas massacre.This western adventure series earned a Primetime Emmy in 1955.. Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle. Plus, Bruce Bennet stars as Quantrill, with Steve Darrell as Bloody Bill Anderson.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Detectives Matt and Frankie investigate a woman named Cattle Kate who seems to be the source of cattle ranches suffering major losses in Sweetwater, Wyoming.This western adventure series earned a Primetime Emmy in 1955.. Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle. Cattle Kate: Jean Parker. Episode first aired in 1954.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Detective Frankie finds herself caught in the middle of a train heist led by the Sam Bass gang.In order to get to Sam, she pretends to be a waitress and flirts with one of his henchmen. This western adventure series earned a Primetime Emmy in 1955..Directed by William Witney. Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle. Don Haggerty plays Sam Bass, while Denver Pyle is his henchman, Bill Hayes.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Jim Davis stars as Matt Clark, a detective who faces the notorious gunslinger Johnny Ringo after finding him responsible for a train robbery. Directed by William Witney. Also starring Mary Castle. Donald Curtis, Emlen Davis, Lee Roberts, Harry Lauter, and Ralph Sanford. Directed by William Witney. Episode originally aired March 4, 1954.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: After shooting Luke Grayson in self-defense, Ben Cartwright must protect himself from Graysons son, Todd, who seeks to avenge his fathers death.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: The Cartwrights try to invalidate a Spanish land grant to stop the De La Cuesta family from taking part of the Ponderosa and all of the Carson Valley settlers' land.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.sub-title: S01 : E22 Blood on the Land
programme.desc: Adam Cartwright finds himself hostage to Jeb, a dangerous sheep herder who wants Ben to sign over a large plot of land.Starring Michael Landon as Little Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Ben helps three deserters, escaped from an Army stockade. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Yodelin' Kid from Pine Ridge
programme.desc: Cowboy icon Gene Autry is framed for murder in this tale of warring cattlemen and turpentiners. The music driven western from director Joseph Kane (Flame of Barbary Coast) includes such familiar faces as Smiley Burnette, Charles Middleton, and Betty Bronson. In between gunshots you'll hear plenty of traditional cowboy songs, including She'll Be Coming 'Round The Mountain, and Red River Valley, plus Gene's version of Sing Me a Song of the Saddle.

programme.title: Frontier Justice
programme.desc: Hoot Gibson is back! But he never imagined he'd find his father in an insane asylum and his cattle ranch overrun with sheep! Worst of all, Roger Williams stars as the diabolical James WIlton, a rival who isn't above murder. For trivia buffs: Director Robert F. McGowan was the man behind several of the classic Our Gang comedies...

programme.title: Young Buffalo Bill
programme.desc: Roy Rogers stars in this highly fictionalized account of Bill Cody's life from director Joseph Kane (Dakota, Flame of Barbary Coast). What it lacks in accuracy is made up for with adventure, as well as and some of Roy's great cowboy songs, including 'Blow Breeze Blow', and 'Rollin' Down to Santa Fe'. Other stars include George 'Gabby' Hayes, Chief Thundercloud, and the lovely Pauline Moore (Young Mr. Lincoln, Charlie Chan at Treasure Island)

programme.title: Buffalo Stampede
programme.desc: A big time cast, including Randolph Scott, Buster Crabbe, Barton MacLane, and Harry Carey star in this feature about stampedes, Indian attacks, and plundering thieves! Directed by the esteemed Henry Hathaway (True Grit, Niagara).

programme.title: Captain Apache (Edited Version)
programme.desc: After Harry T. Collier, a beloved commissioner of Indian Affairs, is murdered in late March during the1880s, Captain Apache, an Indian graduate of West Point, is assigned by the army to investigate the crime. Suspecting that O.J., the sheriff of a town bordering the reservation may be involved in the killing, Apache travels there and finds the sheriff dining with his mistress Maude at the Paradise Saloon. Before Apache can question him, however, O.J. abruptly departs and rides out of town with Apache in pursuit. When Apache apprehends him, O.J. swears that he did not kill Collier and relates that the agents dying words were April Morning. Meanwhile, Griffin, a wealthy landowner and six of his henchmen deliver guns across the border to a corrupt Mexican general who is bent on overtaking the province by force. When Griffin then demands that the general now fulfill his part of the bargain, the general orders him killed, unaware that his lieutenant, Sanchez is in Griffins employ. Rather than killing Griffin, Sanchez shoots the general, and after promoting himself to the post, promises Griffin that he will cross the border in time for April Morning. When O.J. is found murdered, Apache questions Maude, who reveals that O.J. traveled to a Mexican cantina monthly. Apache then rides to the cantina, where he is met by a cavalry patrol led by Sgt. ORourke. Upon learning that the cantina owner has recently been killed, Apache demands that the mans widow, Rosita, take him to Rodriguez, her husbands employer. Rosita then introduces Apache to a Mexican sergeant who allegedly knows where Rodriguez can be found. Unaware that the sergeant is Rodriguez disguised as a soldier, Apache follows him to a church where the priest claims that Rodriguez has claimed sanctuary and is therefore immune to the law.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: John Wayne stars as Ted Hayden, a tough hombre who goes undercover to join a gang led by a heartless fiend known only as Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock). Gentry is out to take over a ranch belonging to one of Hayden's friends, but as Hayden finds out, Gentry has a lot more than that up his sleeve. You'll have to watch this two-fisted Western to find out the rest!

programme.title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
programme.desc: The Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, killing all but one. The surviving ranger is nursed back to health by Native American Tonto, and takes on the identity of a masked vigilante, determined to bring all outlaws to justice. Culled from episodes of the popular TV series, this feature is great fun for fans of the Lone Ranger. Starring Clayton Moore and Jay Silverheels.

programme.title: Lost Canyon
programme.desc: When Johnny Travers (Jay Kirby) is falsely accused of robbing a bank, it's up to Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) to clear his name and find the real villains. There's nothing better than watching Hoppy get rough with the rustlers, and it's all the better when you get to hear the Sportsmen Quartette sing (I got Spurs) Jingle, Jangle, Jingle.

programme.title: The Kansan
programme.desc: Richard Dix stars in this epic of the boisterous and brawling Old West! Wounded in a gun battle with the notorious James gang, John Bonniwell (Dix) wakes up in the hospital to find out hes been elected marshal! He quickly learns that this hot-headed frontier town can only be cooled off with blazing lead and dynamite! Jane Wyatt, Albert Dekker, Victor Jory, and Robert Armstrong also star in this tale of smashing fists and crashing bullets from director George Archainbaud (The Lost Squadron).

programme.title: Bulldog Courage
programme.desc: Tim McCoy, one of the unsung heroes of 1930s western pictures, stars in a dual role. First, hes Slim Braddock, a miner who turns to robbing stagecoaches after being swindled by a banker. When Slim is murdered, his son Tim, also played by McCoy, seeks vengeance. Directed by B-movie legend Sam Newfield for Excelsior Pictures, this film is a showcase for McCoy, who appeared in more than 90 movies and in 1960 earned a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame!

programme.title: Red Ryder: Roll, Thunder, Roll!
programme.desc: Red Ryder finds two silver conchas, the trademark of bandit El Conejo, at a raided ranch. He reports the raid to Marshal Bill Faugh but tells him that he suspects that El Conejo, a Robin Hood type character, is being framed.

programme.title: Hit the Saddle
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers get involved when a local sheriff is killed in this B-western from Republic Pictures. The trouble starts when a villainous rancher (J.P. McGowan) plots to steal some government protected horses. Bob Livingstone, Max Terhune, and Ray Corrigan star as the gallant Mesquiteers, while a young Rita Hayworth (Gilda, The Lady From Shanghai) appears as a sexy saloon singer who turns a Mesquiteer's head.

programme.title: Hellgate (Edited Version)
programme.desc: In 1867 Kansas, veterinarian Sterling Hayden treats an injured stranger who turns out to have been a guerrilla raider--and Hayden soon finds himself serving a term in one of the world's most terrifying prisons under sadistic commandant Ward Bond. Adapted from the story of Dr. Mudd, the physician who attended John Wilkes Booth, assassin of President Lincoln.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Cisco witnesses a dog identifying the murderer of his master. He then tries to prove that the dog is right. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951. This episode aired in 1950.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: A man confesses to a murder he did not commit in order to pay for his mother's surgery. Cisco and Pancho work to prove his innocence. programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Detectives Matt and Frankie make their way to the town of Coffeyville where they run into the Dalton brothers who are seeking to commit a double bank robbery. Also starring Myron healey, Robert Bray and Robert Foulk. Look for future Daniel Boone/Davy Crocket star Fess Parker as a member of the Dalton gang. Episode originally aired in 1954.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Detective Matt Clark and his partner Frankie head to Tombstone, Arizona to find Doc Holliday with suspicion that Holliday is involved in the gang activity there. Starring Jim Davis, Mary Castle, Kim Spalding, Frank Richards, James Craven amd Harry Harvey. Directed by William Witney. Episode originally aired in 1954. Series won an Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Following their activity with the Quantrill Raiders, the Younger Brothers return on the scene to commit a bank robbery in Minnesota. Detectives Matt and Frankie work to put a stop to their plan. Starring Jim Davis, Mary Castle, George Wallace, Gregory Walcott, Louise Beavers, and Sheb Wooley. Directed by William Witney. Epsiode originally aired in 1954.Series won an Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: The notorious John Wesley Hardin kills two people while on a cattle drive to Abilene. Matt and Frankie head out to bring him to justice. Richard Webb stars as John Wesley Hardin. Also starring Jim Davis, Mary Castle, Howard Negley, Robert Karnes amd John Eldredge. Directed by William Witney. Episode originally aired April 9, 1954.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Hawkeye and Chingachcook go up against two thieves with stolen identities. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Hawkeye and Chingachcook suspect that a young man's uncle is behind the recent attacks against him. Hawkeye: John Hart. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper.Episode originally aired in 1957.

Episode originally aired in November, 1957.

programme.desc: A town turns against Eben Cotten as he is accused of selling rifles to the Indians. Hawkeye: John Hart. programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Hawkeye learns that his brother has joined the British army and is now a redcoat. However, when he is murdered by a treacherous Indian companion, Hawkeye seeks revenge. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: Bells of San Angelo
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Dale Evans team up in this tale of silver mines, kidnappings, and secret passages. Roy plays a border guard who has to rescue Dale from the clutches of underhanded miner Rex Gridley (John McGuire). How does he do it? With help from Trigger, of course! With a cast that inclues Andy Devine as Sheriff Cookie Bullfincer, director William Witney gives us an enjoyable drama from the golden era of Republic Pictures!

programme.title: Home in Oklahoma
programme.desc: The entire gang is here! Roy Rogers, Dale Evans, Gabby Hayes, and Trigger are all involved in a murder mystery involving the death of a wealthy ranch owner. Songs include I Wish I Was A Kid Again and Cowboy Ham and Eggs.

programme.title: Way of the West
programme.desc: Government agent Gordon (Hal Taliaferro) goes undercover to investigate an ongoing war between cattlemen and sheepmen. But he soon finds himself framed for murder! This low budget western from the short-lived Empire Pictures is from the golden era of shoot em ups, when audiences knew who the bad guys were, and couldnt wait for the good guys to serve up some just punishment!

programme.title: Mohawk
programme.desc: Kurt Neumann (The Fly, Rocketship X-M) directed this bawdy tale of a love that was louder than war drums! With a cast that includes Scott Brady, Rita Gam, and Neville Brand, the story takes place on a remote army post where an artist romances a trio of women, just as a vengeful settler turns the army and the local Iroquois tribe against each other. Film buffs might like to know that the cinematography for this feature is by four-time Oscar nominee Karl Struss, who won an Academy Award in 1929 for his work on Sunrise.

programme.title: McLintock
programme.desc: He likes his whiskey hard... His women soft... And his west all to himself! Inspired by Shakespeares The Taming of the Shrew (1594), John Wayne (The Searchers, Stagecoach), Maureen OHara (Miracle on 34th Street, The Parent Trap), and Patrick Wayne (The Searchers, The Alamo) star in this western comedy directed by Andrew V. McLaglen (Gunsmoke, The Wild Geese). George Washington McLintock (John Wayne) is the wealthiest man in his territory who utilizes his power and influence to maintain order between farmers, ranchers, Indians, corrupt government officials, and his own family! McLintock is McNificent!

programme.title: City Restart
programme.desc: City Restart charts the story of a period unprecedented in City’s history and shows fans what has been required to ensure the Club resumes safely against the backdrop of the global COVID-19 health crisis.

programme.title: City Restart
programme.desc: The eagerly-awaited second episode of our new three-part documentary series has landed and is available exclusively on City+.

programme.title: City Restart
programme.desc: City Restart, our fascinating new three-part CityTV documentary series, offers fans a unique insight into our return to action amid a world turned upside by a global health pandemic.

programme.title: Mediterranean Kitchen Italy
programme.desc: Chef Kurt welcomes Chef Fausto into the kitchen to learn the craft of a Roman icon: authentic Pasta all'Amatriciana, perfected with crispy guanciale and rich pecorino cheese. As they toss the pasta, the duo explores what makes Italian cooking so timeless: simplicity, incredible ingredients and great company.

programme.title: Makarska
programme.desc: In Makarska, where the Biokovo mountain meets the sea, we explored local flavors with chef Mario Tomaš. On the menu: "utisno" shark, a Venetian-influenced specialty, and njokada—a cinnamon-spiced twist on pašticada.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Marseille
programme.desc: Malini Angelica travels to Marseille, France’s vibrant Mediterranean port city. She explores its historic Old Port, colorful neighborhoods, and bustling markets, discovering the city’s unique blend of French and North African influences. From sampling local dishes like bouillabaisse to soaking in seaside views and street art, Malini uncovers what makes Marseille one of France’s most dynamic and diverse cities.

programme.title: MED Destination KEFALONIA
programme.desc: WITH VO

programme.title: Rick Steves Europe
programme.desc: When Rome was little more than a village, Athens was already laying the foundations of Western civilization. And today, amid its rich heritage, Greece’s vibrant capital continues to thrive.

programme.title: Med Destinations ITHAKA
programme.desc: WITH VO

programme.title: Opera - Salome
programme.desc: The 87th Festival of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino opens with Richard Strauss's Salome, conducted by Alexander Soddy. Directed by Emma Dante, this new production features Lidia Fridman as Salome, Anna Maria Chiuri as Herodias, and Nikolai Schukoff as Herodes. The performance blends Strauss's intense musical drama with a fresh and dynamic staging.

programme.title: Whats On - 8 - Books Literature Innovation and Learning
programme.sub-title: Whats On - 8 - Books Literature Innovation and Learning
programme.desc: Great ideas are the lifeblood of the Mediterranean and this week we are following them from the written page to the boardroom. We start at the Malta Book Festival, where the local community gathers to celebrate the stories that define the islands. Our journey then takes us to Cyprus for the Nicosia Book Fest to see how literature creates a unique bridge between cultures. In Spain, we wander the famous leafy avenues of the Madrid Book Fair, where Retiro Park becomes one of the largest outdoor libraries in the world. We wrap up at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for the EU Startup Summit, where the creative energy of storytelling meets the high-stakes world of global innovation. This is a look at the parks and the halls where the next chapter of the Mediterranean is being written.

programme.title: Mediterranean Yoga Start Your Day Gently
programme.sub-title: Mediterranean Yoga Start Your Day Gently
programme.desc: Mediterranean Yoga is a series that blends Embodiment Yoga with the peaceful beauty of the Mediterranean. Set in stunning coastal and natural locations, each episode encourages viewers to reconnect mind and body through gentle movement, breathwork, and mindfulness in a safe and calming space.

programme.title: Memoirs 10 Nov
programme.desc: Memoirs 10 Nov

programme.title: Isabella Turso Sliding Doors
programme.desc: An Original Music Video by Isabella Turso

programme.title: Whats On - 9 - Trade, Exhibitions and Unique Experiences
programme.sub-title: Whats On - 9 - Trade, Exhibitions and Unique Experiences
programme.desc: There is a unique energy that takes over the Mediterranean as the summer heat begins to build. This week, we are bypassing the usual tourist routes to find the heartbeat of the region through its most spectacular festivals. Imagine the sun setting over a lake in Tuscany as the Puccini Festival opens its 72nd season with the powerful melodies of Turandot. From that timeless elegance, we head straight into the high energy of Malta, where the Isle of MTV and the 10th anniversary of the Glitch Festival are turning the islands into a global hub for electronic music. We also explore the stunning heights of the Spanish Pyrenees for the floating stage at Pirineos Sur and hit the iconic cliffs of Santorini for the urban vibes of the Supa Dupa Fly Festival. This is a journey through a region that knows exactly how to celebrate its past while dancing firmly into the future.

programme.title: Med Minds 10 Julius Caesar
programme.desc: Julius Caesar, the formidable leader of ancient Rome, became a lasting symbol of ambition, power, and transformation, shaping the destiny of the Mediterranean world through conquest, vision, and a legacy that endures beyond his dramatic fall.

programme.title: Memoirs 10 Nov
programme.desc: Memoirs 10 Nov

programme.title: Med Nations 07 Croatia
programme.desc: Sail along the stunning Adriatic coast of Croatia. From the medieval streets of Dubrovnik to sunlit islands and crystal-clear waters, Croatia reveals a rich tapestry of history, culture, and seaside traditions that make it a Mediterranean gem.

programme.title: Med Destinations Malta
programme.desc: Med Destinations uncovers the magic of Malta, an island rich in history, culture, and stunning coastal landscapes. From medieval streets to turquoise waters, Malta is a Mediterranean treasure.

programme.title: Med Destinations Rimini
programme.desc: Med Destinations visits Rimini, Italy’s seaside gem, where golden beaches meet rich history. From Roman ruins to vibrant nightlife, Rimini offers the perfect mix of culture and coastal charm.

programme.title: Fadi Abou Rjeili Sirena
programme.desc: A heartfelt musical tribute to Malta, celebrating the island’s distinctive character, cultural heritage and enduring connection with its people. Set against the backdrop of the Mediterranean, this music video captures the beauty, spirit and identity of the Maltese Island.

programme.title: Outdoor and Nature Ep 5
programme.desc: OUTDOOR & Nature, a weekly program that highlights sports, outdoor activities, and the breathtaking scenery of Cyprus, will introduce you to the great outdoors. Each episode highlights government initiatives, community organisations, and volunteer efforts to preserve Cyprus's natural heritage while examining nature, wildlife, and conservation. Take a trip of inspiration, exploration, and adventure with hosts Panicos Pilalis and Aristo Aristeidou. Listen and get motivated to go on your own outdoor adventure in Cyprus!

programme.title: Help Save the Med HSTM
programme.desc: Help Save the Med highlights actions to protect the Mediterranean Sea, conserve marine biodiversity and promote environmentally friendly methods, raising awareness of the environmental issues facing the region.

programme.title: Mediterranean Kitchen Spain
programme.desc: Chef Antonio teams up with Chef Kurt in the kitchen to prepare a traditional Spanish comfort food: succulent Iberian pork cheek braised in a luxurious red wine reduction and served with creamy truffle mash. As they cook, the two share kitchen stories, personal memories and the moments that shaped Antonio’s love for food. It’s a simple celebration of what Spanish cooking is all about: good hospitality, tradition and the bonds made over a good meal.

programme.title: HIMASS and Pacijenca Project Montenegro
programme.desc: The Europa Nostra Heritage Awards celebrate exceptional projects and achievements in the conservation and enhancement of Europe’s cultural heritage. The awards celebrate work in fields like conservation, research, education, and heritage awareness throughout Europe.

programme.title: Cinematic Kitchen House
programme.desc: Annette's friend Federico presents a unique property comprising three separate buildings: an independent house currently used as a holiday let, a main house divided into upper and lower apartments, and a traditional stone ruin awaiting full renovation. Each space is rich in rustic Italian charm and character.

programme.title: Brač (Supetar)
programme.desc: On Brač, famed for its white stone, Zlatni Rat beach, and Vidova Gora, we stopped in Supetar to taste tradition. Restaurateur Teo Dragičević served us šporka juha, mišanca, and vitalac—authentic island flavors rooted in Brač’s rich culinary heritage.

programme.title: Rick Steves Europe
programme.desc: Slovenia, a small nation of just two million people, is one of Europe’s most surprising delights. Nestled at the crossroads of the Germanic, Mediterranean, and Slavic worlds, it offers a charm all its own.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Napoli
programme.desc: Malini Angelica visits Naples, in Italy’s vibrant Campania region. She dives into the city’s beautiful chaos to uncover the heart of Neapolitan culture, sampling delicious street food, meeting friendly locals, and exploring its rich history. programme.desc: Bass en Celine slapen nog, en de kinderen gaan al wat in de tuin spelen. De bal belandt pardoes in de ruit van de slaapkamer van de ouders. Stradi en Viola vluchten naar hun kamer. Dan vindt Bass de bal, en…

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Het is een hete zomerdag. Stradi wil graag een ijsje, maar Bass noch Viola willen hem geld geven. Dan komt Horn de boel op stelten zetten, en om zijn fouten goed te maken, tracteert hij het hele gezelschap. Stradi gaat de ijsjes kopen, maar wil zelf het allergrootste…

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Stradi verveelt zich te pletter. Plots ziet hij een luchtballon. Horn wenkt hem voor een tochtje. Terwijl niemand op hem let, stapt hij in. Hoog in de lucht ziet hij sterren en planeten. Hij plukt zelfs een ster uit de hemel.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: De hele vioolfamilie is met vakantie. Bij een bergwandeling willen ze de hoogste top bereiken. Ze verliezen de moed niet, overwinnen enkele moeilijkheden, en staan uiteindelijk op de top. Of niet?

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Stradi en Ting Tang spelen met de knikkers. De magische knikker van Ting Tang staat op het spel. Als Stradi hem wint, loopt hij ermee naar Viola. Dan blijkt dat de knikker alleen maar magische kracht heeft in de handen van Ting Tang.

programme.title: Symfollies

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Stradi doet zijn uiterste best om een vlieger op te laten, maar het lukt hem niet. Viola is geen hulp: ze zit een boek over vampiers te lezen. Trump en Tromb geven Stradi een grote vlieger, die hem hoog in de lucht meesleurt. Het wordt een heuse nachtmerrie.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Het heeft gesneeuwd. Stradi en Viola glijden op hun slee tot bij de bevroren vijver. Het ijs is in slechte staat, en het is verboden te schaatsen. Maar Bassoon is op het ijs. Plots breekt het onder zijn voeten. De kinderen moeten hem redden, het koste wat het wil.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Stradi en Viola planten elk een zaadje in een pot. Viola verzorgt het kiemende plantje heel goed, maar Stradi speelt liever buiten. Als hij merkt dat zijn plant veel kleiner is dan die van Viola, komt een lelijk karaktertrekje in hem naar boven.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Stradi en Viola zijn op wandel en komen aan bij de woonwagen van Legato. Ze smeken hem om mee te spelen. Maar Legato heeft het druk met de schoonmaak van zijn woonwagen. Als de kinderen een handje toesteken, gaat het natuurlijk vlugger!

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Uit het huis van Bass verdwijnen allerlei voorwerpen: een krant, een lepeltje, een handdoek en een touw. Hij wil de dief vinden en komt hem op het spoor. Het blijkt Stradi te zijn, die al deze voorwerpen heel goed kan gebruiken.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Stradi heeft gezien dat zijn vader zijn grote verjaardagscadeau in de kast heeft verstopt. Hij kan zijn nieuwsgierigheid niet bedwingen, en staat ’s nachts op om te kijken wat er in zit. Stradi schrikt zich een hoedje! Hij had wel iets anders verwacht!

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Viola en Stradi krijgen muziekles van de juf op school. Stradi wordt vooraan geroepen om een partituur te spelen, maar hij slaagt er niet in. Ze roepen de hulp in van Maestro, de dirigent. Later is iedereen verbaasd over Stradi’s prachtige prestatie.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.sub-title: S01 : E27 Symfollies: De Vallende Ster
programme.desc: Viola kijkt vanuit haar slaapkamer naar de prachtige sterrenhemel. Plots valt er een ster naar beneden. Viola loopt de tuin in en vindt haar. Er is een punt afgebroken. Viola neemt de ster mee naar haar kamer en verzorgt ze met veel liefde.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Vandaag is Staccato een goochelaar. Hij laat zijn mysterieuze toverhoed buiten aan de woonwagen staan. Stradi en Viola zijn nieuwsgierig en laten per ongeluk een muzieknootje uit de hoed ontsnappen.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Celine is jarig. Bass en de kinderen hebben voor een mooie verrassing gezorgd: een tocht met een luchtballon. Door een onhandigheid van Horn moet de ballon landen in het meer. Wat nu?

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: In het bos zijn de vioolkinderen tikkertje aan het spelen. Stradi valt en vindt een bril. Hij zet hem op en is meteen het noorden kwijt. Wat verderop dwaalt Maestro hulpeloos rond, want hij is zijn bril verloren.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Het vliegtuig van Legato valt zonder brandstof en moet in de tuin van de familie viool een noodlanding maken. De kinderen zijn vol bewondering voor de vernuftige machine. Bass vindt een oplossing om Legato te helpen.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Omdat de kinderen vóór het slapengaan geen koek meer krijgen, smeden ze een plannetje. Stradi zal proberen om er slaapwandelend een te bemachtigen. Maar of hun plannetje lukt?

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.sub-title: S01 : E33 Symfollies: Maestro In De Problemen
programme.desc: Als Maestro zijn balkon aan het herstellen is, valt de ladder om. Hij kan zich nog net aan de balustrade vastgrijpen. De muzieknootjes vliegen naar Stradi en Viola om hulp. Zo wordt Maestro net op tijd gered.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Stradi, Viola en Ting Tang organiseren een fietswedstrijd. Na een hevige botsing blijven er van de fietsen alleen nog brokstukken over. Vader Bass mag hier niets van weten. In de garage bouwen de kinderen met alle stukken een nieuwe fiets.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: In het klaslokaal vindt Trump een grote schaar. Hij gaat ermee op pad, en laat een spoor van vernieling achter. Als hij eindelijk gesnapt wordt, moet hij alle schade herstellen.

programme.desc: Het circus is in de stad maar de hoofdact is spoorloos verdwenen. Ernst en Bobbie weten wel een manier om de show door te laten gaan, maar dat blijkt toch moeilijker dan gedacht…

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen bij de boswachter
programme.sub-title: S05 : E02 Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen bij de boswachter: Een wolkenkrabber
programme.desc: Een wolkenkrabber in het bos. Het pannenkoekenhuisje in het bos moet worden gesloopt en meneer Bouwgraag wil daar een groot flatgebouw voor in de plaats neerzetten. Ernst en Bobbie bedenken een listig plan om de sloop tegen te gaan.

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen bij de boswachter
programme.sub-title: S05 : E03 Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen bij de boswachter: Met de trein
programme.desc: Bobbie heeft een groepje kampeerders uit het bos per ongeluk iets meegegeven wat van de boswachter is, maar ze zijn inmiddels al vertrokken met de trein. Ernst en Bobbie gaan proberen om de kampeerders met de trein in te halen| wat leidt tot een wilde achtervolging over het spoor!

programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa vertellen hun avontuur in Peru, waar ze de bus naar de top van de berg hadden gemist en die rijdend op een ezel probeerden in te halen.

programme.title: Mouk
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Mouk: De grote oversteek
programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa vertellen hun avontuur op de rivier Orinoco, waar ze verschillende wilde dieren tegenkomen waaronder een soort krokodil!

programme.title: Mouk
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 Mouk: Klein is fijn
programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa vertellen hun avontuur in Tokyo, Japan, waar ze de laatste hand mee helpen leggen aan een stadstuin.

programme.title: StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag - Chimpansees
programme.desc: Chimpansees zijn erg slim en Saskia van Dierenpark Amersfoort vertelt hoe de apen deze puzzels kunnen oplossen.

programme.title: StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag - Brilberen
programme.desc: Kom erachter wat brilberen eten en wie de vijand van de beer is.

programme.title: StoryZoo & Dirk Scheele
programme.sub-title: S01 : E14 StoryZoo & Dirk Scheele: Metal Battle
programme.desc: Zwart, hard, brutaal en metaal. Het is tijd voor de metal battle.

programme.title: StoryZoo & Dirk Scheele
programme.sub-title: S01 : E16 StoryZoo & Dirk Scheele: De Apenbende
programme.desc: Heb je al gehoord van onze Apenband? We zingen apenliedjes en spelen en eten apennootjes.

programme.title: Bibaboerderij
programme.sub-title: S01 : E26 Bibaboerderij: Viva Maakt het Gezellig
programme.desc: Op de Bibaboerderij beleven boer Bart en boerin Bibi samen met de didadiertjes, fifafruitjes en gigagroentes, de leukste avonturen! Terwijl Bibi goed voor iedereen zorgt, hangt Bart de onhandige boer uit.

programme.title: Bibaboerderij
programme.sub-title: S01 : E27 Bibaboerderij: Een Beetje Heet
programme.desc: Op de Bibaboerderij beleven boer Bart en boerin Bibi samen met de didadiertjes, fifafruitjes en gigagroentes, de leukste avonturen! Terwijl Bibi goed voor iedereen zorgt, hangt Bart de onhandige boer uit.

programme.title: Bibaboerderij
programme.desc: Op de Bibaboerderij beleven boer Bart en boerin Bibi samen met de didadiertjes, fifafruitjes en gigagroentes, de leukste avonturen! Terwijl Bibi goed voor iedereen zorgt, hangt Bart de onhandige boer uit.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E38 De Smurfen: De Verschrikkellijke Sneeuwman
programme.desc: Grote Smurf is gekwetst en om hem te kunnen verzorgen moeten de Smurfen naar de top van een berg gaan, waar een zeldzame bloem groeit, om de pollen ervan te kunnen gebruiken. Maar in de eeuwige sneeuw leeft er een monster dat vrienden wil worden met Smurfin.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E39 De Smurfen: De Smurf Fontein
programme.desc: De Smurfen ontdekken “de fontein der jeugd”. Deze wordt echter bewaakt door een boosaardige trol die het magische boek van Grote Smurf weet te stelen. Ze kunnen Gargamel overtuigen hen te helpen, maar de slechterik valt in handen van de trol.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E40 De Smurfen: Het Paasfeest Van De Smurfen
programme.desc: De boosaardige tovenaar Gargamel vraagt zijn collega Balthazar een recept om de Smurfen te vangen. Het omvat het ontvoeren van Moeder Natuur om de komst van de lente te verhinderen. Gelukkig schieten de Smurfen te hulp.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E41 De Smurfen: De Goeie,de Kwaaie,de Smurfse
programme.desc: Koning Argon is een gespierde, lompe bruut, maar zijn tovenaar Mordain is nog erger. Hij heeft plannen om verschillende Smurfen die hij gevangen heeft genomen te gebruiken om al het goud van de koning te stelen...

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E42 De Smurfen: Zuster Smurf
programme.desc: Smurfin heeft een nieuw vriendinnetje, Laura, een zesjarig meisje dat samen met haar ouders aan de rand van het woud woont. Samen gaan de 2 meisjes op stap in het bos. Maar een oude heks krijgt hen te pakken.

programme.title: Paardenpraat TV
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Paardenpraat TV: Een dag met Britt's paarden
programme.desc: Esra geeft Eve vandaag een glitter make-over. Daarnaast hebben Esra en George elkaar onlangs beter leren kennen. Vandaag zal ze voor het eerst op George rijden. Dit is even wennen maar hoe zien ze er samen uit?

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E43 De Smurfen: Smulpap Smulsmurf
programme.desc: Gulzige Smurf overdrijft het. Hij wordt steeds zwaarder en zwaarder, totdat zijn gewicht hem in gevaar brengt. De gemene Gargamel is van plan om hem te vangen... Kan Gulzige Smurf gered worden door Grote Smurf?

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E44 De Smurfen: De Smurf Die Geen Nee Kon Zeggen
programme.desc: Het is een grote eer voor een Smurf om gevraagd te worden om naar het Moeras te gaan en het zeldzame paddestoel terug te brengen. Maar Bange Smurf aarzelt om de Moerasmonster onder ogen te komen, dus stuurt hij de Smurf die geen nee kan zeggen.

programme.title: Paardenpraat TV
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Paardenpraat TV: Op George rijden zonder hoofdstel en zadel
programme.desc: Britt vond het heerlijk om lekker zonder zadel op Vito te rijden. Op George heeft ze nog niet zo vaak zonder zadel gereden! Britt en George blijven oefenen om steeds beter te worden. Eerst gaat Britt oefenen met George zonder zadel en op muziek, om George te laten wennen. Vervolgens gaat ze op George zonder hoofdstel rijden. Als dat maar goed gaat!

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E19 Naranjina & De Kadekapers: Hondenstreek
programme.desc: Naranjina wil een kat uit een boom redden, maar er breekt een tak af en ze valt. Enkel verstuikt.

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E20 Naranjina & De Kadekapers: Schroefhak
programme.desc: Er drijft een groot plastic verpakt pak met een grote sticker: ‘made in Italy’ in de haven. Naranjina en de kadekapers weten het met veel moeite op de kant te krijgen. Lise blesseert haar hand bij het op de kant krijgen.

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E21 Naranjina & De Kadekapers: Onderduiken
programme.desc: Naranjina racet in een skelter over de kade als ze plotseling een afschuwelijk lelijk wezen ziet. Ze wijkt uit en botst daardoor op een boom. Het zonnepaneel is tot Abduls ontsteltenis kapot. Testrit geslaagd, maar skelter overleden. Ze zullen een nieuw zonnepaneel moeten kopen. Maar die dingen zijn duur…

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E22 Naranjina & De Kadekapers: In de put
programme.desc: Naranjina steekt haar hoofd uit een putdeksel en wordt bijna door een auto overreden die flyers rondstrooit van de grote goochelaar Mantresse… Naranjina kan maar net op tijd haar hoofd intrekken… Snel kruist ze op de plattegrond die ze aan het tekenen is aan dat deze put op een weg uitkomt.

programme.title: Bernard
programme.desc: "Geen sport!" is geen alternatief voor de ruimdenkende ijsbeer Bernard! Geen race is hem te snel, geen berg te hoog en geen water te diep. Kijk dus zelf wat er gebeurt als Bernard het sportveld betreedt.
